title: Entity Zeroo
description: adds Entity Zero creepypasta to Minecraft
body:
- adds Entity Zero creepypasta to Minecraft

If you like MC creepypastas, try this mod ! I created it myself using MCreator. Please note - this mod adds to Minecraft just Entity Zero and spawn egg, it can't spawn in nature, you must use spawn egg. I also added simple crafting recipe for the egg - just 1 stick. I hope, you'll like it !
